field.label: Enable monitoring
field.help: Scan the network periodically and record the devices that are seen.

field.label: Monitor interfaces
field.help: Only devices seen on these interfaces are recorded. Leave empty to monitor every assigned interface.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Debug records each notification attempt, including the transport error behind a failed delivery, in /var/log/devicemonitor.log. Webhook URLs are reduced to their host before logging.

field.label: Notify on
field.help: Which events raise a notification, on both the email and webhook channels. At least one must be selected; switch a channel off to stop its notifications.

field.label: Recipient
field.help: Where notifications about new devices are sent.

field.label: Delivery method
field.help: Local Sendmail needs a working local mailer, for example the os-postfix plugin. Direct SMTP talks to a mail server itself and needs nothing else installed.

field.label: SMTP server
field.help: Only used when the delivery method is Direct SMTP.

field.label: SMTP username
field.help: Leave empty when the server does not require authentication.

field.label: Email: notify for interfaces
field.help: Leave empty to be notified about every interface.

field.label: Webhook type
field.help: Picks the payload format. Detect from the URL looks for "ntfy" or "discord" in it, which is wrong for a self-hosted ntfy on another hostname, so set it explicitly if delivery arrives as raw JSON.

field.label: Skip TLS verification
field.help: Only for an endpoint with a self-signed certificate. A webhook URL normally contains the credential, so leaving this off keeps it from anyone able to intercept the connection.

field.label: Webhook URL
field.help: For example https://ntfy.sh/your_topic, a Discord webhook, or your own endpoint.

field.label: Webhook: notify for interfaces
field.help: Leave empty to be notified about every interface.
